top_signals.title: Stocks, Bonds Climb as Oil Falls on US-Iran Hopes: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks and bonds kicked off the week on a positive note as hopes for diplomatic efforts to end the Iran war drove oil prices lower, easing inflation anxiety.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: White House TV pool won't cover Trump after press ban: CNN
top_signals.summary: The decision comes as CNN, MS NOW and Politico said they are suing Trump to overturn his new ban of those three media outlets from the White House.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Kyle Samani predicts SOL flippening, claims ‘no one’ uses ETH
top_signals.summary: Multicoin Capital co-founder Samani expects SOL to surpass Ether’s market capitalization “this market cycle” and argues that “today, no one really uses Ethereum.”
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
